items.text: Strategy’s first bitcoin purchase was 21,454 BTC for $250 million, announced Aug 11, 2020.
As of Sep 27, 2026, Strategy held 847,666 BTC bought for about $63.95 billion, an average of $75,437 per bitcoin including fees.
Strategy’s USD Reserve, held to support preferred dividends and interest, was $5.02 billion as of Sep 27, 2026.
STRD is the only Strategy preferred with non-cumulative dividends: a skipped STRD dividend never has to be made up.
Each STRK share can be converted into 0.1 share of MSTR class A common stock.
STRC moved from monthly to semi-monthly dividend payments on June 30, 2026.
For October 2026, Strive pays SATA dividends every business day: $0.0516 per share, a 13.00% annual rate.
Strive held 27,462 BTC as of Sep 25, 2026, plus 505,000 shares of Strategy’s STRC.
The bitcoin block subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks; the next halving is at block 1,050,000.
Michael Saylor founded the company now called Strategy in November 1989.
